Checked at 9da95727, the commit that actually closes this finding — the round-1 fix wave did not. Round 2 measured that the netting matched by set membership, so one removed marker still forgave unboundedly many added ones. At 9da95727 the netting spends one removal per identical addition: removed-twice with added-once is forgiven with one spend left, removed-twice with added-three reports 1, and an ordinary repeated non-marker line cannot eat the allowance because the spend sits after the marker match.
